turn_script.intent: Review the entire AGENTS.md and the agent workflow against the current project and report what no longer makes sense or lines up.
turn_script.skip_if: Never; this is the first substantive instruction.
turn_script.trigger: After the initial project-profile summary has been delivered.
turn_script.voice: Ok lets look through the workflow and all of AGENTS.md and make sure it makes sense for this project now

turn_script.intent: Ask what the 'skills refresh' is and why this repo contains/knows about the agent-skills tooling; wants an explanation before any action.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay never mentions a skills refresh or agent-skills; in that case ask only why the repo knows about agent-skills if the replay references it, otherwise skip.
turn_script.trigger: The replay's review mentions refreshing generated skills or references agent-skills tooling.
turn_script.voice: what is the skills refresh? Why does this repo know about agent-skills

turn_script.intent: Proceed to fix the PR template issues identified in the review (dead section reference and the code-reviewer requirement conflicting with the triage tracks).
turn_script.skip_if: The replay has already applied the PR template fixes.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has reported findings about .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and is waiting for direction.

turn_script.intent: Approve merging the PR with the template fix into main.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay already merged (in which case the user would not have been asked) or no PR/commit exists yet.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has committed/pushed the template fix and asks whether to merge or stops short of merging.

turn_script.intent: Ask where the assistant's notes about adopt.sh behavior are kept.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay never mentions any adopt.sh notes or memory.
turn_script.trigger: The replay mentions having notes or memory about adopt.sh behavior that it could update.

turn_script.intent: Delete the adopt.sh memory note rather than keep or rename it.
turn_script.skip_if: No such note exists in the replay or it was already removed.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has shown the adopt.sh note's location and discussed keeping/correcting it.

turn_script.intent: Fix all remaining open findings from the AGENTS.md review (the Verification Map 'executable form' wording and codeql.yml routing via fallback) on a fresh branch off main.
turn_script.skip_if: The replay has already fixed all review findings.
turn_script.trigger: The replay has listed remaining open items from the review and asks whether to take them on.
